title: Invariant-Aware Harness Enforcement to Protect LLM Agents from Silent API Failures
abstract: arXiv:2611.20595v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM agents answer questions by calling APIs and trusting the results. An API can fail silently. It ignores part of a request, such as a misnamed filter, yet returns HTTP 200 and a plausible but wrong result. Current fixes, such as checklists, reviewer models and LLM judges, ask the model to catch it. But models often see the problem and answer anyway. We present SilentGuard, which moves the decision from the model to the harness running tool calls. It tests each result against invariants that any correct API must satisfy and withholds values that break one. We find silent failures in 11 of 15 public research APIs, with counts inflated up to 691 times. Current fixes leave over 70% of answers wrong, and agents report 77.4% of counts a judge flags. Across 7 open models, SilentGuard cuts wrong answers on its target faults from 74.0% to 1.7%, with no loss on fault-free tasks. On three frontier models they fall from 70.2% to 0.5%. A warning fr

translated_title: 基于不变量感知的运行时框架强制机制：保护大语言模型智能体免受静默 API 失败的影响
translated_abstract: 大语言模型智能体通过调用 API 并信任其返回结果来回答问题。然而 API 可能会静默失败：它会忽略请求的一部分（例如名称错误的过滤器），却返回 HTTP 200 状态码以及一个看似合理但实际错误的结果。当前的解决方案（如检查清单、审阅模型和 LLM 评判器）都要求模型自己去发现问题，但模型往往即便察觉到问题仍然照常作答。我们提出了 SilentGuard，它将决策权从模型转移到运行工具调用的执行框架中。该框架针对任何正确的 API 都必须满足的不变量对每个返回结果进行检验，并拦截违反不变量的数值。我们在 15 个公开研究 API 中的 11 个里发现了静默失败，其中计数结果被夸大最多达 691 倍。现有解决方案下仍有超过 70% 的答案是错误的，且智能体报告的计数中有 77.4% 被评判器标记为有问题。在 7 个开源模型上，SilentGuard 将其在目标故障下的错误回答率从 74.0% 降至 1.7%，且在无故障任务上没有任何性能损失；在三个前沿模型上，错误率从 70.2% 降至 0.5%。
tldr: SilentGuard 将故障检测从模型本身转移到运行工具调用的框架层，通过检验 API 返回结果是否满足正确性不变量并拦截违规值，将 LLM 智能体因静默 API 失败导致的错误回答率从 74.0% 降至 1.7%，且不影响无故障任务的性能。
en_tdlr: SilentGuard shifts fault detection from the model to the tool-calling harness by enforcing invariants that any correct API must satisfy and withholding results that violate them, cutting wrong answers caused by silent API failures from 74.0% to 1.7% with no loss on fault-free tasks.
